title: Evia camera route restored
details: Removed the old native phone-camera fallback that was still taking over photo and video evidence
Single evidence tasks now use the same full-screen Evia camera as staged evidence tasks
Photo prompts remain visible on the camera screen
Video keeps the visible prompt, recording timer, Next prompt button and timestamp markers
Camera styling, saving, photo speed, evidence tiles and menu layout are otherwise unchanged
summary: Evia v146 restores the full-screen prompted camera for every visual evidence task.
changes: Use Evia camera for single evidence tasks
